title: Lost and Stolen Devices (Student Technology Device Program Regulation)
content:
**Regulation.** Under the Student Technology Device Program:

1. Only the family reports a device lost or stolen; the support desk records the report and the family confirms it.
2. A lost device is charged the depreciated replacement cost, the loan type's replacement cost of a new device times the depreciation schedule percent of the device's service year; under the Technology Protection Plan the charge is the plan's loss share of that amount, rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up.
3. A stolen device under the plan is charged nothing when a police report number is given within 5 calendar days after the theft, the theft date being day 0; otherwise the theft is charged as a loss.
4. A lost device found and turned in within the same school year credits its loss charge in full with the reason device recovered, less any damage charged on inspection; a device not recovered is charged off after the loss charge posts.

## The loss charge worked through (hypothetical inputs)

Take a hypothetical replacement cost of 333.00 for a device in service year 2, with a depreciation share of 75 percent and, under the plan, a loss share of 50 percent (inputs chosen for illustration):

1. Depreciated replacement cost: 333.00 times 75 percent is 249.75.
2. Without the plan, the charge is 249.75.
3. Under the plan, the charge is 50 percent of 249.75, which is 124.875, rounded to 124.88.

## A theft under the plan

| Hypothetical theft | Police report number given | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| Plan loan | On day 3 after the theft | Nothing |
| Plan loan | On day 5 after the theft | Nothing, day 5 is within the window |
| Plan loan | First given on day 6 | Charged as a loss |
| Plan loan | Never given | Charged as a loss |
| Loan without the plan | Any | Charged as a loss |

## After the loss charge

- Found and turned in within the same school year: the loss charge is credited in full with the reason device recovered, less any damage charged on inspection. A hypothetical device whose loss charge was 124.88, found the same school year and turned in with no damage found on inspection, has 124.88 credited.
- Not recovered: the device is charged off after the loss charge posts.

## Who reports

The report of a lost or stolen device comes only from the family. The support desk records it, and the family confirms it.
